corrections.text: The article states that Cisco's Expressway Core and Edge products "are used for secure remote connections to collaboration services, according to Cisco's security advisory." Cisco's advisory (cisco-sa-vcs-static-cred-hr7EWZ8t) defines the Expressway-C/Expressway-E naming but does not describe the products' purpose; that description is accurate but was not sourced from the cited advisory.
